info.title: Retailer Discovery API
info.description: Backend API for Retailer Discovery & Outreach Studio

schema.title: Response Health Check Api V1 Health Get

get.description:
Returns the operational integration states (live vs mock) of Nebius, Tavily, and Qloo.
Never exposes API keys or secrets.

schema.title: Response Integrations Status Api V1 Integrations Status Get

get.description:
Retrieve the seller profile.
Auto-creates an empty profile row if none exists (DECISION-D16).

put.description:
Update seller profile details (business_name, country, website, contact_email, about).
Persists changes to the database.

get.description:
List all products belonging to the authenticated seller.
Ordered deterministically by created_at desc, id desc.

schema.title: Response List Products Api V1 Products Get

post.description:
Create a new product record stamped with owner_id = current_user.id.
Validates price_min <= price_max and moq >= 1.

get.description:
Retrieve a single product by ID.
Enforces owner_id == current_user.id.
Returns 404 not_found if not found or belongs to another user.

put.description:
Update a product record.
Enforces owner_id == current_user.id (returns 404 if belongs to another user).
Validates price_min <= price_max and moq >= 1.

delete.description:
Delete a product record and cascade delete all child records (DECISION-D12).
Enforces owner_id == current_user.id (returns 404 if belongs to another user).

schema.title: Response Delete Product Api V1 Products  Id  Delete

post.description:
Upload an image for a product.
Validates MIME type (jpeg, png, webp) and size <= 5MB.
Uploads under per-user path, appends URL to product.images, and returns list[str] (DECISION-D18).
Enforces owner_id == current_user.id (returns 404 if belongs to another user).

schema.title: Response Upload Product Image Api V1 Products  Id  Images Post

post.description:
AI Task A: Suggest structured product attributes from free-text description.
Calls get_ai_service().structure_product(description, known).
Does NOT persist to database (seller review required).
Maps ai_output_invalid or timeouts to Appendix A.5 error codes.

Create and queue a new research run.
Verifies product_id belongs to caller.
Supports optional Idempotency-Key header to prevent duplicate runs.
Snapshots provider_modes (ai, search, taste as live or mock).
Triggers Phase 1 of async runner.

get.description: List all research runs belonging to the authenticated seller.

schema.title: Response List Research Runs Api V1 Research Runs Get

get.description: Retrieve details, stage, and plan of a research run.

post.description: Trigger a rerun for an existing research run, copying inputs and merging new inputs.

get.description: Retrieve proposed, candidate, and confirmed anchors for a run.

schema.title: Response Get Run Anchors Api V1 Research Runs  Id  Anchors Get

post.description: Add a custom user-defined taste anchor (DECISION-D3).

Resume run after reviewing anchors (DECISION-D4).
Requires run to be in awaiting_review state.
Requires >= 1 confirmed anchor unless proceed_without_anchors is true (returns 422 on failure).
Stores confirmed anchor_ids in run.inputs and transitions run to queued (stage: discovery).
Triggers Phase 2 of the runner.

get.description: Retrieve market hypotheses with signals for a research run.

schema.title: Response Get Run Hypotheses Api V1 Research Runs  Id  Hypotheses Get

patch.description: Confirm, reject, or edit an anchor. Verifies parent run ownership.

get.description:
List buyer leads with filtering, sorting, and pagination (DECISION-D7).
Enforces strict user isolation: owner_id == user.id.
Retrieve details, scores, and assessment for a single lead owned by the user.

patch.description: Update lead review status (new/saved/rejected/contacted) and notes.

get.description: Retrieve verified evidence items for a lead owned by the user.

schema.title: Response Get Lead Evidence Api V1 Leads  Id  Evidence Get

post.description: Generate a new grounded outreach draft for a lead (AI Task D).

get.description: Retrieve all versioned drafts for a lead ordered by version desc.

schema.title: Response Get Lead Outreach Drafts Api V1 Leads  Id  Outreach Drafts Get

get.description: List outreach drafts across leads with optional filters (DECISION-D17).

schema.title: Response List Outreach Drafts Api V1 Outreach Drafts Get

patch.description:
Update subject, body, manual status, or followup notes of an outreach draft.
Atomic rule (DECISION-D11): when status is set to contacted, atomically update parent lead review_status.

post.description:
Regenerate a new draft version from an existing draft.
Inserts a new row with version = max_version + 1 and parent_draft_id = id (never overwrites).
